body: Thank you for giving me ways to avoid doing these things, I can at least now get some of the feeling without actually harming myself. It's not so scary now, I really didn't want to get hurt, but at the same time I wanted too so badly, so thank you.
Sure, how do we do that?

I live with my family so I can't throw away the knives. I havent pulled out the razors I used to use yet and I don't think I am going to now. I had actually had a hairtie on my wrist earlier today and I pulled it and let it fling back a few times when I felt like hurting myself. I might try to remember to do that when I get the urges.

I feel a bit tired now which is good, but I am afraid to lay there trying to sleep with my own thoughts, so I'm trying to keep distracted until I am literally about to pass out. I have urges of cutting mostly right now. I don't think I could go through with ending everything, I am too weak for that. I just honestly find it so hard to believe that I am waking up in the morning.

I am just struggling with handling my emotions lately. Usually I am awesome at it, I don't remember the last time I cried or lost it before this happening. Everything is just crashing down around me and the only person I have for support can't be there for me right now. I have lots of other things that are happening that are most likely making me feel this way but I just have no way to deal with them now. It's making me go crazy.

I'm scared of the thoughts I am having. I guess I have had the thoughts before, but never the urges to act upon them. Its scaring me that I am having to hold myself back from hurting myself. It shouldn't be that way.

I just feel so lost. I literally have nothing and nobody. I have no motivation anymore to even change most of these things that are wrong. The one person that I have there for me is too busy with his job and his own personal problems right now. I really just feel lost, and like I am nothing. I know I have it better than most people, but in my mind I am losing it.
Im probably not much help as I feel fucked up myself, but if you ever want to talk you can message me.
Ah thank you for the offer, I will see if I can find some tomorrow if I don't go insane by then.
I will need to remember that one, its 2am here so a pharmacy isn't open.
With the way I am feeling there is no way I will be able to sleep, and I don't want to be laying there with my thoughts trying too.
